matches.description: Watch Newcastle vs Brighton highlights and goals from Premier League on ReFooty: Football Highlights Hub. Match played on May 2, 2026. The Premier League clash on May 2, 2026 , between Newcastle United and Brighton promised a tactical battle of contrasting styles under the lights. Both sides entered the contest looking for crucial points to solidify their standings in what proved to be a high-stakes encounter filled with momentum shifts. A Fast Start on Tyneside Newcastle United wasted little time asserting their authority, taking advantage of a lapse in the visitors' defensive concentration early in the first half. In the 12th minute, a major error from Brighton goalkeeper Bart Verbruggen handed the initiative to the hosts. After Bruno Guimarães carved open the play with a sharp pass, Jacob Murphy delivered a precise cross that allowed William Osula to power a header home, sending the home crowd into raptures. The early goal rattled the visitors, and the Magpies continued to press their advantage through set-pieces. That pressure told again in the 24th minute when Newcastle doubled their lead. Bruno Guimarães was once again the architect, swinging in a dangerous corner from the left flank. Defender Daniel Burn rose highest in the crowded penalty area to meeting the delivery, directing a firm header into the back of the net. While Brighton dominated much of the ball possession throughout the opening period, they struggled to convert their 67% control into meaningful chances, leaving them with a mountain to climb as the teams headed into the break. The Seagulls Fight Back Brighton emerged for the second half with renewed vigor, determined to find a way back into the match. Their persistence was rewarded in the 61st minute through a beautifully worked team goal. Danny Welbeck turned provider, shielding the ball effectively before laying it off to Jack Hinshelwood . The young midfielder showed great composure to strike the ball with his left foot, finding the bottom corner and halving the deficit. The goal completely changed the complexion of the match, as Fabian Hürzeler ’s side began to lay siege to the Newcastle goal. As the clock ticked toward the final ten minutes, the tension on the pitch boiled over, resulting in a flurry of bookings for both sides. Sandro Tonali and Yoane Wissa were cautioned for the hosts, while Hürzeler himself received a yellow card for dissent on the touchline. Brighton came agonizingly close to an equalizer in the 86th minute when Charalampos Kostoulas unleashed a spectacular bicycle kick, only to be denied by a world-class save from Nick Pope . Moments later, Pope was called into action again, comfortably catching a goal-bound header from Olivier Boscagli to preserve the narrow lead. Late Tension and the Decisive Blow In a frantic final sequence, both teams had golden opportunities to change the scoreline. Brighton ’s Yankuba Minteh missed a clear opening in the 89th minute, dragging his effort wide after being found by Georginio Rutter . Newcastle responded with a counter-attack of their own, but substitute Yoane Wissa could not capitalize on a cross from Lewis Hall , sending his shot wide of the target. With five minutes of added time signaled, the visitors pushed everyone forward in a desperate search for a draw. However, the comeback hopes were finally extinguished in the 96th minute following a defensive blunder by Jan Paul van Hecke . After being booked just moments earlier for a foul, the defender's mistake allowed Harvey Barnes to seize possession. The clinical winger made no mistake, cutting inside and firing a left-footed shot into the net to make it 3-1. The late strike ensured the victory for Newcastle , punishing Brighton for their missed opportunities and sealing a vital three points in front of a jubilant home support.

The atmosphere at St. James' Park was electric as two Premier League sides took the pitch for a contest that promised high drama and intense tactical warfare. An explosive start On May 17, 2026, Newcastle United flew out of the blocks, forcing the issue early on. The breakthrough arrived in the 15th minute when Nick Woltemade pounced on a defensive blunder to fire a clinical volley into the net. Just four minutes later, the momentum paid off again as William Osula doubled the lead, beating the keeper with a precise left-footed strike from outside the box. Despite West Ham United attempting to find a foothold through set-pieces, they struggled to break down a resilient home defense during the opening half. Asserting authority The second half saw the visitors push for a way back into the game, with Valentin Castellanos entering the fray to add attacking bite. His impact was palpable, highlighted by a fierce volley that rattled the crossbar in the 78th minute. Yet, the day belonged to the hosts. William Osula etched his name into the headlines once more in the 65th minute, finishing neatly to secure his brace. In front of a crowd of 52,206, Newcastle held firm to claim a deserved victory, marking a standout performance that leaves their fans delighted.

matches.description: Watch Nottingham Forest vs Newcastle highlights and goals from Premier League on ReFooty: Football Highlights Hub. Match played on May 10, 2026. The stands at the City Ground vibrated with an intense football duel this Sunday afternoon as Nottingham Forest and Newcastle United faced off in another round of the Premier League . The match, held on May 10, 2026, provided a display of tactics and resilience that kept fans in suspense until the final whistle. Balance and Caution in the First Half The first half was characterized by mutual scouting and a few defensive errors that could have been costly. Nottingham Forest attempted to take control of the game early, with Neco Williams swinging dangerous crosses into the box. In the 18th minute, Igor Jesus sent a promising header toward goal, but goalkeeper Nick Pope was well-positioned to halt the hosts' momentum. On the Magpies' side, the response came through Joelinton , who missed a headed opportunity shortly before the break, during a period where a mistake by Nicolas Dominguez in the Forest defense nearly opened the path for an opponent's goal. Barnes' Impact and Anderson's Response The second half brought increased aggression and yellow cards for Igor Jesus and Ryan Yates , reflecting the growing tension on the pitch. In the 74th minute, the deadlock was finally broken. Harvey Barnes , who had come off the bench shortly before, took advantage of a precise pass from Jacob Ramsey to finish with his right foot and put Newcastle United ahead. The goal seemed to stun Forest, but the substitutions made by the home side proved decisive. Nottingham Forest 's persistence paid off in the 88th minute. In a display of determination, James McAtee set up Elliot Anderson , who made no mistake and fired home with his left foot to restore parity, sparking euphoria in the stands. In stoppage time, the game became frantic with Lorenzo Lucca having a goal ruled out for offside and Matz Sels securing the draw with a safe intervention following a Barnes cross, sealing the final result in a duel where neither side was willing to back down.
